description: This file defines the ModuleBuilder class which provides methods to automate and test the process of creating, selecting, and deploying modules in SuiteCRM's Module Builder interface. It contains functions for creating modules of various types, selecting existing packages and modules, waiting for UI elements to disappear, and deploying packages.

classes.name: ModuleBuilder
classes.description: A helper class for automating module creation, selection, and deployment in SuiteCRM's Module Builder, inheriting from the Administration class.

methods.name: createModule
methods.description: Creates a new module within SuiteCRM's Module Builder, optionally creating a new package if it does not exist, and deploys it.

methods.name: selectPackage
methods.description: Navigates to and selects an existing package in the Module Builder.

methods.name: selectModule
methods.description: Navigates to and selects an existing module within a package in the Module Builder.

methods.name: waitUntilPopupSuccessDisappeared
methods.description: Waits until confirmation popup messages in the UI have disappeared.

methods.name: deployPackage
methods.description: Deploys a specified package in the Module Builder interface, optionally accepting a popup confirmation if the package already exists.
